title: Review Budget and Circuit Breaker
objective: Bound semantic review loops with an atomic event ledger and deterministic per-run circuit breaker.
description: Classifies review attempts, reserves capacity before provider invocation, isolates concurrent runs, and requires an authorized human decision when budget is exhausted.
parallel_safe_reason: Budget events mutate the same run-scoped review state consumed by later decisions and must land on the finalized finding policy.
must: Classify full, targeted, retry, and external events only from explicit immutable command intent and request-envelope identity.
Increment review_count for full and targeted events, full_revision_count only for a complete replacement with an explicit reviewed parent, and targeted_amendment_count only for targeted events.
Prevent findings owned by later implementation phases from consuming a full technical-plan revision.
Store an append-only run-scoped event ledger and derive all counts from it.
Reserve semantic review capacity atomically before provider invocation.
Prevent concurrent commands from overspending the same run budget.
Count an accepted external review in its declared full or targeted class.
Finalize and consume the reserved semantic event as invalid-output when a provider payload is received but fails contractual validation, while preserving the last valid review.
Convert only a pre-payload transport or timeout failure with the same request-envelope digest to retry without semantic consumption.
Return REVIEW_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED without invoking the provider when exhausted.
Expose approve-with-conditions, reject, transfer-findings, create-follow-up, and targeted-amendment as governed next actions after exhaustion.
Require verified authorization and an audit event for every budget extension.
Keep events and counts isolated across simultaneous runs.
not_included: Finding propagation to specs or PRs.
External review import workflow beyond deterministic event classification.
Load or performance testing without new evidence of a bottleneck.
acceptance: AC-07 is satisfied for deterministic event classes, atomic reservation, exhaustion, retry behavior, and authorized extension.
AC-08 is satisfied for budget and review event isolation by run.
Concurrent reservation never permits semantic review consumption above the configured run budget.
Exhaustion is detected before provider invocation and returns both required machine codes.
Exhaustion projects the five governed next actions without executing any automatically.
Human and JSON budget counts derive from the canonical event ledger.
Technical retry and external review behavior is covered by focused fixtures.
Invalid provider payload consumes its reservation, records invalid-output, and leaves the last valid review current.
